assumptions: The CDS is in frame and the codon choices come from the chosen organism's table.
limits: Silent at the protein level only: mRNA structure and codon context are not scored.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which fewest silent codon changes remove the forbidden restriction sites from a CDS?

description: Propose the minimal SILENT synonymous edits that remove forbidden restriction sites from a CDS (a design/write).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

table.description: the codon-usage table to guide synonym choice, BY NAME, as the Codon Usage panel lists it. This is the way to pass a table: it resolves against the tables loaded in this project, so the numbers come from one someone built or fetched. Leave unset and the active table is used.

table_tsv.description: ONLY for a table you are pasting yourself, measured elsewhere — prefer `table`, which names one this project already has. Do NOT write a table out from memory: codon frequencies are measured data, and a typed one is indistinguishable from a real one in the result. TSV: codon<TAB>count. Advanced.

name: scrub_restriction_sites

fixes.description: one entry per synonymous swap made
